verdicts.title: Time's Arrow in a Quantum Universe: On the Status of Statistical Mechanical Probabilities
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In a quantum universe with a strong arrow of time, it is standard to postulate that the initial wave function started in a particular macrostate--the special low-entropy macrostate selected by the Past Hypothesis. Moreover, there is an additional postulate about statistical mechanical probabilities according to which the initial wave function is a "typical" choice in the macrostate (the Statistical Postulate).
